Jwt.//: Token signing key. Set via user-secrets or the Jwt__Key env var - do not commit it. Must be at least 32 bytes; startup fails if it is missing or too short.

Auth.//: Session cookie policy. Set CookieSameSite=None when the frontend is served from a different site than this API - browsers only accept that with CookieSecure=true over HTTPS. Leave CookieSecure=true outside of plain-HTTP local testing.

Cors.//: Browser origins allowed to call this API. Override per environment, e.g. Cors__AllowedOrigins__0=https://inventria.example.com

Seed.//: First-run Admin and Employee demo accounts. Set AdminPassword/EmployeePassword via user-secrets or the Seed__AdminPassword/Seed__EmployeePassword env vars for a real deployment - do not commit real values here. Left blank, both default to the password 'password', logged once at startup as a reminder.
